packageRules.description: Disable nix manager for playwright-web-flake to avoid conflict with custom regex manager

Group playwright across npm and flake.nix into a single PR. The flake driver's browsers.json revision names the PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH directories that the npm playwright-core looks up from its own bundled revision, so the flake ref and both npm pins must move together or every browser test fails to launch. Both the upstream and the fork coordinates are listed so the group survives a fork-drop, and the fork's tags mirror upstream's exactly, so the two coordinates share one continuous version series.
Pin playwright npm packages to exact versions for flake input sync

The rust nightly channel is a derived constraint (aeneas -> charon pin -> required nightly), not a free-floating dependency; surface drift on the dependency dashboard but never open a PR automatically
@cloudflare/vite-plugin bundles an exact wrangler and emits config fields that a mismatched wrangler CLI rejects; bumping either alone breaks the docs build

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits@10 requires conventional-changelog-writer@9, which semantic-release@25's bundled @semantic-release/release-notes-generator@14 does not resolve; hold on 9.x until semantic-release ships a compatible generator
